name: Agent17
source:
You're a pretty average, unnoticed student at school. You don't stand out and sometimes even get bullied or pushed around by troublemakers. One day, while heading home, you find a broken phone, and everything changes.

This phone can solve all your problems. There's a mysterious person, Agent17, who follows the commands of whoever has the phone, letting you tell her to do anything. Suddenly, your life gets way better. You get back at the bullies and the teachers who treated you badly.

Your boring school life becomes interesting as you meet talented and fascinating people, learning their secrets. With Agent17's help, you start uncovering even more mysteries. You realize there's a lot more to discover in your life, and the adventure is just beginning.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/hexatail]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
你是学校里一个平凡又不起眼的学生。毫不出众，有时还会被不良学生欺负、推搡。某天放学回家的路上，你捡到一部损坏的手机，一切从此改变。

这部手机可以解决你的所有烦恼。一位名叫17号特工的神秘女性，会服从手机持有者的命令，你可以让她做任何事。你的生活突然大为好转，得以报复那些欺负你的学生，以及曾经苛待你的老师。

随着结识才华出众、充满魅力的人，并了解他们的秘密，原本无聊的校园生活变得有趣起来。在17号特工的帮助下，你开始揭开更多谜团。你意识到，自己的人生还有许多未知等待探索，而冒险才刚刚开始。

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/hexatail]Patreon[/url]]
